title: fix(core,drivers,formula,metadata,objectql,platform-objects): refusals, field help and log lines state each decision in words instead of a tracker number (stage 5)
body:
Part of #20513
Clause-②: no

**Stage 5 of this lane (the other seven packages, plus the `objectql` `findOne` refusal stage 3 held), under the maintainer's A / A ruling on the card: the author-visible text and the log lines.** The stage is over the ~80-string stop line (94 ledgered literals plus 2 URL-form messages), so it lands in two parts: this PR carries every refusal, prescription, metadata text and log line, and the 28 `src/`-shipped test strings are reported as stage 5b below. #20513 remains open for stage 5b, so this PR carries no closing keyword. Text only: no error `code`, field name, HTTP status, export or control flow moves.

## What this does

Refusals, prescriptions, field help and log lines in `core`, `driver-memory`, `driver-mongodb`, `formula`, `metadata`, `metadata-core` and `platform-objects` (and the one held `objectql` string) sent the reader to a tracker number for the reason behind them. Each rewritten string now says the reason in words (form D, as the migration-entry rewrite and stages 1 to 4 applied it). Where the sentence already stated the decision, only the citation goes; where an ADR stood beside the number, the ADR stays. Where the sentence did not carry the decision, it now does:

| Where | Cited | The sentence now says |
|---|---|---|
| `core` `IMetadataService.register` refusals (thrown, 400) | 7378 rows 3 and 1 | "... so the contract refuses loudly and never coerces a value into storability" / "... so the contract refuses loudly and names the mismatch" |
| `core` init-order fault suffix on a `getService` miss during `init()` (thrown) | 4131 | "a composition/ordering fault; registration order is not a contract." |
| `core` admin standing surface ledger reasons | 8613, 11663 | "`active`, which this resolver honours"; "RECLASSIFIED from `reads-only` when the config anchor landed" |
| `driver-mongodb` retired aggregate function (thrown, 400) | 6188, 5907 | "was REMOVED from @objectstack/spec AggregationFunction (ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove: no SQL backend compiled it)" |
| `driver-mongodb` undeclared aggregate function (thrown, 400) | 5907, 12818 | "before this refusal, this builder answered any unrecognised name with a $sum of that column ..." |
| `metadata` route ledger note (HMR POST route) | 12140 | "CHANGED when the development-only mount gate landed" |
| `metadata` history-seq failure (error log) | 4825 | "numbering it from 1 (what this code once did) would collide ..." |
| `driver-memory` / `driver-mongodb` multi-tenancy refusals (`MEMORY_MULTI_TENANT_UNSUPPORTED`, `MONGODB_MULTI_TENANT_UNSUPPORTED`) | 6915, 16589, 3724 as tracker URLs | The trailing `Tracking:` line and its URL constants go; the consequence sentence above it already says the driver refuses rather than run (or answer) unisolated. |

Every other rewritten literal loses only its citation.

**The `findOne` pair.** `objectql` `engine.ts` `requireFindOnePredicate` and `metadata-core` `engineFindOnePredicateRefusalMessage` are byte twins compared by `objectql`'s `engine-findone-predicate.test.ts`, so both drop the citation in one commit (`0a25891e6d`) and the parity pin stays byte-exact.

**Metadata text.** The `sys_account` token help, the `sys_email` headers help and the SCIM credential store's protection reason drop their numbers in the source. The `en` bundle is regenerated with `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write --filter=platform-objects`: the generator rewrote the four `en` leaves from the source and kept every translated-locale value verbatim (merge mode). So the number inside the three translated `sys_account` token helps (es-ES, ja-JP, zh-CN) leaves only by editing those values, which AGENTS.md permits for translated-locale values (keys and structure untouched). None of those leaves has a source-hash companion entry (they are translations, not source copies), so nothing falls back; `check:i18n` and `check:i18n-stale-fill` are green.

**The URL-form ids (bounded in-place fix).** The claim names `driver-memory`'s URL-form id (the per-call seam's dead card link). The same `Tracking:` line carries a second URL on both seams, and `driver-mongodb`'s twin guard carries the same line. All three go together: same defect class as this card, a mechanical fix, files inside this stage's surface, and no new verification surface (each package's own tests, re-pinned). These are the only changes that move code shape (two module constants and one ternary that only composed the removed line).

## Stage 5b (the rest of this stage, not in this PR)

The `src/`-shipped test strings, 28 literals carrying 32 occurrences in 6 files, all case labels or suite titles: `metadata-core` `contract-suite.ts` (1 `describe` title), `engine-delete-dispatch.ts` (4 case labels), `engine-findone-predicate.ts` (3 case labels), `engine-update-dispatch.ts` (15 case labels, 18 occurrences), `object-schema-fls-contract.ts` (2 case `why` texts, 3 occurrences), and `driver-mongodb` `test-mongod.ts` (3: a skip reason, a warning and a thrown message), whose number two assertions in `mongodb-memory-server-gate.test.ts` pin. After 5b these packages leave the ledger entirely and the card can close.

## Text-only proof

A TypeScript-AST skeleton of each changed source file (every string literal and template text one placeholder, pure-literal `+` operands collapsed, comments never read) at merge base `4d0b9cd542` and head `1432546ac8`: 27 of 29 files SAME; 2 DIFF, the two tenancy guards, whose diff is exactly the removed URL constants, the removed `tracking` ternary and the removed `Tracking:` line. Control: the same tool reports DIFF on `rest` `import-template.ts` across `6f1f1c1035` (a real code change).

## Tests (head `1432546ac8` unless noted)

- Build: `turbo run build` over `./packages/*` and `./packages/*/*`, 71/71, after the merge of `origin/main`.
- `@objectstack/objectql` `vitest run --project local`, three shards after the merge: 116 + 116 + 115 files, 2260 + 2011 + 2528 tests passed. `typecheck` exit 0 (test layer: 40 files / 234 errors / 65 signatures held in the debt ledger, unchanged).
- At `214951a19c` (the incoming `main` commits touch none of these packages): `core` 61 files / 1795 tests; `driver-memory` 65 / 1413; `driver-mongodb` 29 passed, 5 skipped / 661 passed, 172 skipped (the skips need a MongoDB server); `formula` 42 / 1240; `metadata` 55 / 828; `metadata-core` 16 / 298; `platform-objects` 59 / 948. Each package's `typecheck` exit 0.
- Consumer check: `plugin-dev` `dev-plugin-optional-load-failure.test.ts` (reads the `driver-memory` refusal) 10 / 10.
- Consumer pins: every string fragment of every removed source line was searched across all 4298 test files in the repo; no test pins a fragment that no longer exists, other than the number pins re-pinned here.

**Re-pins (8 assertions in 8 test files), each proven able to fail.** The number pins in `health-monitor.test.ts`, `authz-cache-posture.test.ts`, `mongodb-aggregation.test.ts`, `mongodb-unrecognised-aggregate-function.test.ts`, `mongodb-tenancy-guard.test.ts`, `memory-tenancy-guard.test.ts`, `memory-tenant-scope-refusal.test.ts` and `objectql` `engine-update-dispatch.test.ts` now assert the sentence that states the decision.

**Ablation and mutations, one-off, on the committed head (`214951a19c`), under a restore trap, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`:**

- `metadata-core` face alone (objectql's tests resolve it through `dist/`): the `findOne` twin and the id-predicate message each marked, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-core build`, `ablation-dist-preflight` marker present in 2 built files. `engine-findone-predicate.test.ts` + `engine-update-dispatch.test.ts`: 10 failed / 83 passed (9 parity cases, 1 re-pin). Restore: blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty for both, rebuild, preflight `--absent` (absent from all 12 built files), rerun 93 / 93.
- Source-imported re-pins (no build leg): health-monitor 1 failed / 25; authz posture 1 failed / 21; the two MongoDB retired-aggregate files 4 failed / 31; MongoDB tenancy 1 failed / 16; driver-memory boot 1 failed / 19; driver-memory per-call 1 failed / 10. Every restore: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. After the run: `git diff HEAD` 0 bytes, `git status --porcelain` 0 lines.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (no paths) at `1432546ac8`: 78 commands, 39 paths vs merge base `4d0b9cd542`, 309 changed lines. All 78 run one at a time from the worktree, each exit 0; `--ran`: "78 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 78 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)". Among them: `check:doc-authoring` (549 pinned sites across 175 files, no growth, no burn-down unrecorded), `check:i18n` (9 packages in sync), `check:i18n-stale-fill`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:driver-conformance`, `check:driver-memory-census`, `check:engine-double-contract`, `check:type-check-debt`. Also run after the merge: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` exit 0.

Narrowed lint: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the 37 changed `.ts` files: 37 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings (count read from eslint's JSON; none ignored). The resolved `parserOptions` are `ecmaVersion: latest, sourceType: module` with no `project` or `projectService`, so no type-aware rule runs and this diff cannot move an untouched file's verdict. Repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.

NOT MEASURED locally (CI's): the live MongoDB cells of `driver-mongodb`, the Test Core shards, Dogfood, the workspace type-check lanes.

## Acceptance notes

- `origin/main` was merged once before opening (`1432546ac8`); its only overlap is `objectql` `engine.ts`, in disjoint hunks, and `objectql` was re-tested after the merge.
- `#20822` group 1b (branch `claude/issue-20822-g1b-f3-route-then-delete`) edits `metadata` `database-loader.ts` in `queryHistory`; this PR touches that file only at the history-seq error line, in a different hunk. Whichever lands later merges `main`. It does not touch `filter-refusal.ts`.
- The es-ES, ja-JP and zh-CN `sys_email.headers_json` help values were translated from an older source revision and lack its last sentence (never returned on the generic data path). They carry no source-hash entry, so they are legacy-trusted and never reported. Noted, not filed; no carrier.
- The `$null` diagnostics in `driver-memory` and `driver-mongodb` still describe the backends' old disagreement in the past tense, while the Turso diagnostic (stage 4) says every driver now refuses it. Both are true; only the wording differs. Noted, not filed.
- Code comments and docblocks in these files still cite ids; they are outside this ruling.
